sections.Profile:
The "Liberty Belle" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in January 1962, is a four-player, electro-mechanical game with an American patriotism theme. Designed by Wayne Neyens and featuring artwork by Roy Parker, it includes four flippers, three pop bumpers, two passive bumpers, two slingshots, and four roto-targets.
